newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court leaves anti-dumping measures on potassium permanganate.
newsitem.headline: Court leaves anti-dumping measures on potassium permanganate.

text.p: The European Court of Justice confirmed on Thursday that Community anti-dumping measures on potassium permanganate originating in China are valid.

The court reiterated principles of GATT that condemn dumping, the practice of selling below the market price, if it causes or threatens material injury to an established industry in the importing country.
Reference by the Finanzgericht Hamburg (Germany) for a preliminary ruling in the proceedings pending before that court between

on the validity of Council regulation No 1531/88 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of potassium permanganate originating in the People's Republic of China and definitively collecting the provisional anti-dumping imposed on those imports (OJ 1988 L 138, p. 1)

Consideration of the question referred has revealed no factor of such a kind as to affect the validity of Council regulation No 1531/88 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of potassium permanganate originating in the People's Republic of China and definitively collecting the provisional anti-dumping duty imposed on those imports.
